title: Norman Granz's dinner and eating contest in Boston
summary: Bellson won an eating contest at a Granz dinner, and Oscar Peterson and Granz had drinking contests.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Fine guy. And Norman Granz used to give -- have dinners for the guys, you know.
Yeah.
And we were in Boston. And Ella Fitzgerald, Oscar Peterson, Basie's band was in, and also Louis Bellson, he invited Louis Bellson and Pearl Bailey.
Yeah.
And we went down to this Chinese place, and Norman bought all the food.
Wasn't that nice?
And we had a big eating contest.
Oh, for heaven's sake.
And that includes everybody that was on the concert.
Isn't that wonderful?
And guess who won the contest in eating?
I don't know.
Louis Belson was still eating after everybody was finished.
Isn't that unbelievable? What an amazing thing.
And Pearl Bailey was still eating.
Isn't that funny?
We couldn't eat any more. Eddie Jones, the bass player?
Yeah.
He couldn't eat no more. I was full,
Oscar Petersen, he couldn't eat any more. There was Louis Bellson, still eating.
That's funny, isn't it?
Basie couldn't eat any more.
That's funny.
I'm telling you, it was just one of those things, like we used to have drinking contests between Oscar Petersen and Norman Granz. They were going to drink each other under the table.
No kidding. That's funny.
Drinking, like, Schnapps and aqua vite. Had to take them both home.
How funny.
Gee.
